## What's new in Igggy 0.1.17
- **Notes are ready sooner.** Igggy starts writing as soon as you press Stop, instead of first re-reading the whole recording. After a 30-minute meeting the note is saved in about 40 seconds, down from about a minute. - **Rewrite any note.** Use the toolbar's Rewrite button to redo a note with another model. If that model runs in the cloud, Igggy asks before sending the note to Anthropic or OpenAI. A rewrite started right after a recording waits for the speaker names first. - **One place to watch notes being written.** Every note shows its steps in the bar at the bottom of the window. Anything else being written or waiting sits in a small queue beside the record button. - **Imported audio gets speaker labels.** Igggy now tells the voices in an audio file apart and labels them Speaker 1, Speaker 2 before writing the note. - **The menu bar holds still.** When two meetings are coming up, they take turns every 8 seconds and fade from one to the next, and the icons beside Igggy's stay put. Point at a shortened meeting name to see all of it. - **Today's next meeting stands out.** It sits in its own card on Today, with room around it. - **Recording starts sooner.** The recording page comes up the moment you press Record. - **Google sign-in opens in Apple's sign-in window.** Signing in or connecting Google Calendar no longer opens a browser tab, and if it fails, Igggy tells you why. - **Fixes.** Calls record the other side again: computer sound could stop after the first moment of a recording. Record no longer crashes with some microphones. Notes written with your own Claude key work again on the newest Claude models. Today's tip about adding another calendar now shows only when Igggy reads a single calendar. - **The local Qwen option is gone.** In our tests it left out most of a long meeting. Notes are written by Apple Intelligence, or by Claude or GPT with your own key.
